# Project Phoenix v47.0 — Western-Eurasia Alt-History 1: Varna Victorious: Three-Crown Balkan Crusade (1444-1520).
# Pure native EU5 1.4.9 Interactive Situation (`is_data_map = yes`, live `oe_v47_varna_momentum` -100..+100).
# Human-friendly & AI-restrained via `is_ai = no` or future `global_var:oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed`.
# Generated by gen_v470_alt_varna_rus_andalus.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v47_varna_crusade = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_v47_varna_crusade

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 1444
		current_year <= 1520
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v47_varna_ended }
		country_exists = c:TUR
		OR = {
			country_exists = c:POL
			country_exists = c:HUN
			country_exists = c:BYZ
			country_exists = c:WAL
			country_exists = c:SER
			country_exists = c:VEN
		}
		OR = {
			has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				OR = {
					tag = POL
					tag = HUN
					tag = BYZ
					tag = TUR
					tag = WAL
					tag = SER
					tag = BUL
					tag = VEN
					tag = LIT
					tag = ALB
					tag = KNI
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							region = region:balkan_region
							region = region:carpathia_region
							region = region:anatolia_region
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			tag = POL
			tag = HUN
			tag = BYZ
			tag = TUR
			tag = WAL
			tag = SER
			tag = BUL
			tag = VEN
			tag = LIT
			tag = PAP
			tag = ALB
			tag = KNI
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					region = region:balkan_region
					region = region:carpathia_region
					region = region:anatolia_region
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Varna Victorious — Liberation of Rumelia & Balkans
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_varna_end_crusade_victory"
		desc = "oe_v47_varna_end_crusade_victory_desc"
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_varna_momentum }
					var:oe_v47_varna_momentum >= 75
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				AND = {
					current_year >= 1452
					NOT = { location:edirne = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { tag = TUR } } }
					NOT = { location:varna = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { tag = TUR } } }
				}
			}
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						has_variable = oe_v47_varna_crusade_camp
						tag = POL
						tag = HUN
						tag = BYZ
						tag = WAL
						tag = SER
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 15
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_varna_triumph years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:TUR }
				c:TUR = {
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_varna_crusade_reckoning years = 25 mode = replace }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Ottoman Counter-Jihad Triumph — Crescent Over the Danube
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_varna_end_ottoman_triumph"
		desc = "oe_v47_varna_end_ottoman_triumph_desc"
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_varna_momentum }
					var:oe_v47_varna_momentum <= -75
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				AND = {
					current_year >= 1460
					location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { tag = TUR } }
					location:varna = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { tag = TUR } }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_varna_momentum }
						var:oe_v47_varna_momentum <= -30
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
			}
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_ended value = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:TUR }
				c:TUR = {
					add_prestige = 15
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_varna_rumelian_mastery years = 30 mode = replace }
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					has_variable = oe_v47_varna_crusade_camp
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_varna_crusade_reckoning years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Danubian Partition & Armed Truce (1520 Horizon)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_varna_end_danube_stalemate"
		desc = "oe_v47_varna_end_danube_stalemate_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1520
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						has_variable = oe_v47_varna_crusade_camp
						has_variable = oe_v47_varna_ottoman_camp
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_varna_crusade_reckoning years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_momentum value = 15 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				OR = {
					tag = POL
					tag = HUN
					tag = BYZ
					tag = WAL
					tag = SER
					tag = VEN
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_crusade_camp value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:TUR }
			c:TUR = { set_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_ottoman_camp value = 1 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu1_1_seen }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu1_1_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu1_ev_cd value = 1 days = 360 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v47_eu1.1
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_varna_momentum } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_momentum value = 15 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v47_varna_momentum < 72
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_three_crown_compact
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_danube_wagon_forts
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_strait_blockade
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_momentum add = 0.30 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v47_varna_momentum > -72
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_ottoman_counter_jihad
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_momentum add = -0.35 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_varna_momentum > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_momentum value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_varna_momentum < -100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_momentum value = -100 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v47_varna_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_variable = oe_v47_varna_crusade_camp
						tag = POL
						tag = HUN
						tag = BYZ
						tag = WAL
						tag = SER
						tag = VEN
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_varna_map_crusade_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = TUR
						has_variable = oe_v47_varna_ottoman_camp
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_varna_map_ottoman_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:balkan_region
					region = region:carpathia_region
					area = area:thrace_area
					area = area:bulgaria_area
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_varna_map_front_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_variable = oe_v47_varna_crusade_camp
						tag = POL
						tag = HUN
						tag = BYZ
						tag = WAL
						tag = SER
						tag = VEN

		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = TUR
						has_variable = oe_v47_varna_ottoman_camp
					}
				}
			}
			value = red_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:balkan_region
					region = region:carpathia_region
					area = area:thrace_area
					area = area:bulgaria_area
				}
			}
			value = blue_light
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v47_varna_legend_crusade"
